logic_gate.configuration.smartRedstoneWi:
If enabled, redstone wires will only automatically connect to input sides used by the current mode.
For instance, redstone wires will only automatically connect to the back input side when the logic gate is in BUFFER mode, not the left and right input sides.
Note: Existing redstone wires need to receive a block update after changing this setting.
